notes.title: Twilight Oracle is in the works - a new point and click adventure by Cosmic Void
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm working on Twilight Oracle, a fantasy comedy point and click adventure. 

You can wishlist it and check out the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2338490/Twilight_Oracle/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38522519/0113e8be42b260b07b6676f2d7f4beeeb0d4a612.png[/img]


Journey to a strange world in search of the fabled Oracle in this fantasy comedy point & click adventure. Play as Leo, a struggling student with the ability to breathe underwater, and explore a desert island and the depths of an alien ocean to uncover your school’s dark past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38522519/a4045e09574b2f092a3bafdcf009ee9698078c7b.png[/img]

Yours, 
Cosmic Void

notes.title: The Corruption Within is on sale -- get it now for 25% off!
notes.notes:
The Corruption Within is on special sale, get it now for 25% off! 

The Corruption Within is a psychological thriller, point-and-click adventure game.

Synopsis: You have just enjoyed a camping holiday with your family when your wife and two young children go missing. With no way to contact anyone you head towards the only source of civilization for miles around - a grand old mansion by a lake. You soon find yourself drawn into a bigger mystery while you desperately try to find your family.

If you get the game, please consider leaving a review, we'll appreciate it a ton!

Have fun!

notes.title: The Corruption Within is out now!
notes.notes:
After a year of development The Corruption Within is out! You can get it now for 10% off during the first week. Please consider leaving a review, it helps a lot! 

Synopsis: You have just enjoyed a camping holiday with your family when your wife and two young children go missing. With no way to contact anyone you head towards the only source of civilization for miles around - a grand old mansion by a lake. You soon find yourself drawn into a bigger mystery while you desperately try to find your family.

We can’t wait to hear what you think of the game!

notes.title: The Corruption Within Teaser Demo Is Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

The Corruption Within Teaser Demo is available for you to download and play! It's a very short demo that is designed to give you a taste of the graphics, music, mood and atmosphere. It's light on puzzles.

The demo contains three scenes, three songs, a bunch of rooms, two NPCs, and one pickable item.

I'd love to hear of your impressions!

Have fun!
